questions.question: If the diameter of a solid hemisphere is 14 cm, then what will be its total surface area? (π = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
**Given: **

The diameter of the hemisphere is 14 cm

**Formula Used: **

The total surface area of the hemisphere = 3πr²

Radius = Diameter/2

**Calculation:**

The radius of the hemisphere = (14)/(2) cm

⇒ 7 cm

The total surface area of hemisphere = 3 × π × (7)2 cm2

⇒ 3 × ((22)/(7)) × 49 cm2

⇒ 3 × 22 × 7 cm2

⇒ 462 cm2

∴ The total surface area of the hemisphere is 462 cm2

questions.question: A and B working separately can do a piece of work in 21 and 24 days, respectively. If they work for a day alternately with A beginning the work, it would be completed in _________.
questions.solution:
Given:

A and B working separately can do a piece of work in 21 days and 24 days respectively.

Calculations:

Time is taken by A to complete the work = 21 days 

so part of the work done by A in 1 day = (1)/(21)

similarly, part of the work done by B in 1 day = (1)/(24)

Work done by (A + B) in 2 days = ((1)/(21) + (1)/(24)) = (15)/(168) = (5)/(56)th part of work

Work done by (A + B) in 11 pairs of days i.e.,

Work done by (A + B) in 22 day = (5×11)/(56)=(55)/(56)th part of work

Remaining work = 1 - (55)/(56) = (1 )/(56)th part of work

On the 23rd day, again A will work separately. So,

Time is taken by A to complete the (1 )/(56)th part of the work 

= (1)/(56) × 21 days 

= (3)/(8)

Total time taken = 22 + 3/8

∴ The correct answer is 22(3)/(8) days.

questions.question: If the 3-digit number 2x3 is divisible by 3, then the value of x² + x is (consider the maximum value of x):
questions.solution:
**Given:**

2x3 is divisible by 3.

**Concept used:**

Divisibility rule of 3.

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

2 + x + 3 = 5 + x is divisible by 3

Hence, possible values of x are 1, 4, and 7.

But we have to take the maximum possible value i.e., 7.

Hence, x = 7

Rightarrow x² + x = 7² + 7 = 56

therefore**The value required is 56.**

questions.question: In an election between two candidates, 10% of the voters did not cast their vote and 5% of the votes polled were found invalid. The successful candidate got 55% of the valid votes and won by a majority of 1710 votes. How many voters were enrolled?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

10% of voters did not cast their votes i.e., 90% percent of eligible votes were caste,

In 5% were invalid and the successful candidate got 55% of the valid votes and won by a majority of 1710 votes.

**Calculations:**

55% of votes got by the successful candidate so, the rest votes i.e., (100 - 55)% = 45 % of valid votes got by the unsuccessful candidate.

According to the question,

1710 votes are (55 - 45) % = 10 % of total valid votes.

1710 = 10% of total valid votes

⇒ 1710 = 10% of (95% of the votes cast)

⇒ 1710 = 10% of {95% of (90% of enrolled voters)}

⇒ 1710 = ((10)/(100)) × ((95)/(100)) × ((90)/(100)) enrolled voters

⇒ 1710 × 1000000 = 85500 × enrolled voters

Enrolled voters = 20000

**thereforeNo. of enrolled voters is 20, 000.**

questions.question: 15 identical solid spherical balls of radius 5 cm are melted to form a single sphere. In this process, 35% of the mass is wasted. What is the radius (in cm) of the single sphere that is now formed? [Use π = 22/7, and give your answer correct to two decimal places.]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

15 identical solid spherical balls of radius 5 cm are melted to form a single sphere.

In the process, 35 % of the mass is wasted.

**Formula used:**

mass = Volume x Density

mass propto Volume

Volume of sphere = (4)/(3)πR³

**Calculations:**

Let the radius of the single sphere be R.

Since 35 % of the sphere is wasted, 65 % would have been used for transforming.

65% of 15 × (Volume of identical solid spherical balls having radius 5cm) = volume of a single sphere

0.65 × 15 × (4)/(3) × π × 5³ = (4)/(3)× π × R3

⇒ 0.65 × 15 × 5³ = R3

⇒ 1218.75 = R³

⇒ R = (1218.75)¹/³

⇒ R = 10.68 cm

**therefore The radius of the single sphere is 10.68 cm.**

**Note: **

R = (1218.75)1/3

We can find the correct answer by using approximation. We can see that 1218 is the value between the cube of 10 ( 10³ = 1000) and 11 (11³ = 1331) and by observing options we can easily choose the correct answer.

questions.question: If (x + (1)/(x)) = (11)/(5), what is the value of (x³ + (1)/(x³))?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct formula: If x + 1/x = a, then x³ + 1/x³ = a³ − 3a

Here, a = 11/5

x³ + 1/x³ = (11/5)³ − 3 × (11/5)

x³ + 1/x³ = 1331/125 − 33/5 = (1331 − 825) / 125

x³ + 1/x³ = 506/125 = 4 6/125

**∴ The correct answer is 4 6/125.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x + 1/x = 11/5

**Formula Used:**

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Cubing both sides of the given equation:

⇒ (x + 1/x)³ = (11/5)³

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ + 3 × x × 1/x × (x + 1/x) = 1331/125

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ + 3 × 1 × 11/5 = 1331/125

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ + 33/5 = 1331/125

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ = 1331/125 − 33/5

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ = 1331/125 − (33 × 25) / (5 × 25)

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ = (1331 − 825) / 125

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ = 506/125 = 4 6/125

**∴ The correct answer is 4 6/125.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Higher Power Algebraic Identities

If x + 1/x = a, the square relation is x² + 1/x² = a² − 2, and the fourth power relation is x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = (a² − 2)² − 2.

Negative Form Algebraic Identities

If x − 1/x = a, the square relation is x² + 1/x² = a² + 2, and the cube relation is x³ − 1/x³ = a³ + 3a.

questions.question: The side of a square is 5 cm. If the side is doubled, by how many times will the area of the square increase?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Side of square = 5 cm

**Concept Used:**

Area of Square = Side²

**Calculation:**

**⇒ **Area of Square = 5² = 5 × 5

⇒ Area of Square = 25 cm²

⇒ When the side is doubled,

⇒ Side of a square = 2 × 5 = 10 cm

⇒ Now, Area of Square = 10² = 10 × 10

⇒ Area of Square = 100 cm²

⇒ Number of times the area of the square increases = (100 - 25)/(25)=3 times.

**Hence, the number of times the area of the square increase when the side is doubled is 3 times.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**

There is a difference in the final area & increase in area.

**NOTE: **Students usually get confused about how many times increment and how many times become.

Which type of car constituted 30% of all cars produced by the company during 2013?

**Concept Used:**

Percentage Composition = Percentage of cars × Total cars

questions.question: A manufacturer sells an item to a wholesale dealer at a profit of 11%. The wholesaler sells the same to a retailer at a profit of 15%. The retailer in turn sells it to a customer for ₹17,045, thereby earning a profit of 19%. The cost price of the manufacturer is (consider integral part only):
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Item sold to customer by retailer at profit percentage = 19%

Item sold to customer by retailer = Rs 17,045

Profit percentage made by wholesaler by selling an item to retailer = 15%

Profit percentage made by manufacturer by selling an item to wholesale dealer = 11%

**Concept Used:**

Cost Price = 100times(SP)/(100+Profit Percent)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Cost price of the item when the retailer sells an item to a customer = 100times(17045)/(100+19)

⇒ Cost price of the item when the retailer sells an item to a customer = (1704500)/(119)=14,323

⇒ Selling price for the wholesaler who sells to a retailer = Rs 14,323

⇒ Cost Price of an item for wholesaler at a profit of 15% = 100times(14323)/(100+15)

⇒ Cost Price of item for wholesaler at a profit of 15% = (1432300)/(115)=12,455

⇒ Selling price for the manufacturer who sells to wholesale dealer = Rs 12,455

⇒ Cost price of item for the manufacturer at a profit of 11% = 100times(12455)/(100+11)

⇒ Cost price of item for the manufacturer at a profit of 11% = (1245500)/(111)=11,220

**∴ The cost price of an item for the manufacturer is Rs 11,220**

questions.question: A grocer has a sale of ₹8,435, ₹8,927, ₹8,855, ₹9,230 and ₹8,562 in 5 consecutive weeks. How much sale must he have in the 6th week so that he gets an average sale of ₹8,500?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Earning in consecutive five weeks = Rs 8435, Rs 8927, Rs 8855, Rs 9230 and Rs 8562

Average sale after 6th week = Rs 8,500

**Concept Used:**

Average = Total sum of values ÷ Number of values

**Calculation:**

**⇒ **Let the sale for the 6th week be Rs x

⇒ Sale average for 6 weeks = (8435+8927+8855+9230+8562+x)/(6)

⇒ Putting the given value of average after 6 weeks,

⇒ (8435+8927+8855+9230+8562+x)/(6)=8500

⇒ 8435 + 8927 + 8855 + 9230 + 8562 + x = 8500 × 6 = 51,000

⇒ 44009 + x = 51000

⇒ x = 51000 – 44009 = 6991

**∴ The sale required for the 6th week is Rs 6,991**

questions.question: Ram is travelling at a speed of 72 km per hour while Shyam is travelling at a speed of 90 km per hour. What is the difference in their speeds (in metres per second)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of Ram = 72 km/h

Speed of Shyam = 90 km/h

**Concept Used:**

1 km/h = (1000)/(3600) m/sec

**Calculation:**

**⇒ **Difference in speed of Ram and Shyam = 90 – 72 = 18 km/h

⇒ Change km/h into m/sec by multiplying (1000)/(3600)

⇒ 18 km/h = 18 × (1000)/(3600) = 5 m/sec

**∴ The difference in their speeds (in metres per second) is 5 m/sec.**

questions.question: Two parallel chords are drawn in a circle of diameter 10 m. The length of a chord is 8 m and the distance between the two chords is 6 m. Find the length of the second chord.

OB = OQ = 5 m (Radius of a circle)

AB = 8 m and MN = 6 m

Let OM be x, then

MB = 8 ÷ 2 = 4 m

⇒ In right-angled triangle MOB, (OB)2 = (OM)2 + (MB)2

⇒ 5 2 = OM 2 + 4 2

⇒ OM 2 = 25 – 16 = 9

⇒ IF = 3 m

⇒ Putting the value of x, ON = 6 – 3 = 3 m

⇒ In right-angled triangle ONQ, (OQ)2 = (ON)2 + (NQ)2

⇒ 5 2 = 3 2 + NQ 2

⇒ NQ 2 = 25 – 9 = 16

⇒ NQ = sqrt16=4 m

⇒ PQ = 2NQ

⇒ PQ = 2 × 4 = 8 m

∴ The length of the other chord of a circle is 8 m.

⇒ New Expenditure = Rs. 120 × 1 kg = Rs. 120

Percentage decrease in consumption of rice

⇒ ((120-100)/(120)) times 100 \% = 16.67 \% 

**∴ The correct answer is option (3)**
